entities.summary: Grace Carpenter Hudson (1865–1937) was an American painter based in Northern California. She was nationally known during her lifetime for a numbered series of more than 684 portraits of local Pomo communities. She painted the first, National Thorn, after her marriage in 1891. Her last work was completed in 1935.
